title: Fix newly added users: missing user ID display in panel and login failure

requirements.text: Fix the backend addUser function in main.mo so that when a new user is successfully created, a valid and unique user ID is generated and stored with the user record. The returned user object must include the assigned user ID. Ensure the ID is not empty, null, or undefined after creation.

quotes: after the user will be added the user id is not showing

acceptanceCriteria: When admin creates a new user via addUser, the backend assigns and persists a non-empty unique user ID to the record.
The addUser function returns the newly created user record including the generated user ID.
No user record exists in the backend store with a missing or empty ID after creation.

requirements.text: Fix the UserManagementPage.tsx user table so that after a new user is created, the user's ID is correctly displayed in the user list/table panel. The table must render the user ID column value for every user row, including newly created users.

quotes: after the user will be added the user id is not showing panela

acceptanceCriteria: After successfully adding a user, the user table refreshes and shows the new user's ID in the ID column.
No user row in the table displays a blank, undefined, or missing ID value.
The user list re-fetches (React Query invalidation) immediately after a successful addUser mutation so the new record appears without a manual page reload.

requirements.text: Fix the login flow so that newly created users (added via the Admin's Add User form) can successfully log in with their assigned email and password. Audit the backend login function in main.mo to ensure it looks up users by email against the full users map (including dynamically added users, not just pre-seeded accounts), verifies the hashed password correctly, and returns a valid session token and role on success. Ensure AuthContext.tsx correctly processes the login response and stores the token and role in sessionStorage.
acceptanceCriteria: A user created via the Add User form can log in immediately after creation using the email and password provided during creation.
The backend login function finds dynamically added users by email (not only pre-seeded users).
On successful login, a session token and the user's role are returned and stored in sessionStorage by AuthContext.tsx.
After login, the newly created user is routed to the page appropriate for their role (Staff → Order Creation, Delivery → Delivery Dashboard, Distributor → Distributor Dashboard, Admin → Dashboard).
No 'invalid credentials' or 'user not found' error is shown for a valid newly created account.

constraints: Do not change the existing pre-seeded demo accounts (admin@vitalist.com, staff@vitalist.com, delivery@vitalist.com, shajan@vitalist.com).
Do not break the existing session-based auth pattern — token/email/role stored in sessionStorage must remain the auth mechanism.
Frontend immutable paths (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui) must not be modified.
nonGoals: Changing the password hashing algorithm or auth mechanism.
Adding new user roles beyond the existing four (Admin, Staff, Delivery, Distributor).
Modifying the QR workflow, order creation flow, or store management.
